## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional after Mr. Phillips's farewell speech and eager about the arrival of Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. However, during the tea party, Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice a strange taste in Anne's cake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035)_

> During tea with Mr. and Mrs. Allan, Anne's homemade cake is discovered to have been accidentally flavored with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects optimistically to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that tomorrow is a new day free of mistakes.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

A New Departure in Flavorings P54](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0054)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks to the graveyard, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as they share their feelings about memory, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on the graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. Allan, and they walk home together while reflecting on teaching, ideals, life choices, and the value of friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) frantically decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally destroys the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and a series of mishaps ruins the meal and results in Miss Barry's expensive platter being broken. A later letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her bitter disappointment.
>
